login.title: Sign in
login.ssoFailed: Single sign-on didn’t complete. Try again, or use your password.
login.ssoOnly: Your workspace signs in through its own single sign-on.
login.secondIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Timeclock.
login.recoveryIntro: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up your authenticator. Each works once.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we’ll send a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sent: If {email} has an account, a link is on its way. It works for an hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: You’ll be signed in, and signed out everywhere else.
reset.rule: At least 10 characters. A few words work well.

invite.title: Join {workspace}
invite.introNew: You were invited as {email}. Set up your account to start tracking time.
invite.introKnown: You were invited as {email}, which already has an account. Enter its password to join.
invite.name: Your name
invite.rule: At least 10 characters. A few words work well.
